Extensions and agent state for Devin Desktop (formerly Windsurf). Extensions can be moved using `--extensions-dir "$XDG_DATA_HOME/devin/extensions"` in a wrapper script and updating your `.desktop` file.

However, `argv.json` and agent state are still hardcoded here.

_Relevant issues:_ https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/162712 , https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/3884

Created on remote hosts. Relocatable only for Remote-SSH via the client's `settings.json`:

```json
"remote.SSH.serverInstallPath": {
  "my-host": "$HOME/.local/share/devin-server"
}
```

Global SSH defaults are unsupported.

_Relevant issue:_ https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/3884
Legacy directory from older Windsurf versions prior to the Devin Desktop rebrand. If you have migrated your settings to `~/.devin`, this directory can be safely deleted.
Legacy configuration directory from Codeium/Windsurf. If not using standalone Codeium plugins and migrated to Devin Desktop, this directory can be safely deleted.
Legacy remote server directory from older Windsurf versions. Can be safely deleted from remote hosts.
Default scratchpad directory created by older Windsurf Cascade sessions. Can be moved to your preferred projects folder or safely deleted if empty.
